result.title: Tanawpamana: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Philippine Cultural Heritage Sites
result.summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used to identify and describe places, yet their recognition and knowledge of specific cultures remain poorly understood, particularly in underrepresented regions such as the Philippines. This study introduces the Tanawpamana Dataset, a repository of Philippine heritage site images with metadata based on the Talapamana registry of the National Commission for Culture and the Arts of the Philippines. We also introduce the Tanawpamana Benchmark, comprising 4,046 tasks designed to evaluate models' recognition and knowledge of heritage sites. Evaluating seven vision-language models, we find that they struggle more with fine-grained visual discrimination among similar heritage sites than with coarse recognition, and that their geographic knowledge is weaker when inferred from image inputs than from text.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建 Tanawpamana 数据集与基准（4,046 项任务），基于菲律宾文化遗产登记信息考察七个 VLM 对文化遗产地的识别与知识，发现细粒度区分相似遗址比粗粒度识别更难，且从图像推断地理知识弱于从文本推断。
AI.relevance_reason: 该基准属识别与知识评测，未涉及 latent 推理状态或推理期证据生成；但「图像输入不如文本输入」的模态差距可能作为视觉证据是否被真正使用的诊断线索，可供核查。
